text: もし　まけてても　わすれとる！

patterns.name: 〜ても
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus も means 'even if', and もし at the front makes the 'if' clearer. もし まけてても = 'even if I had lost'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus いる shows a state that still holds. まけてて is short for まけていて, and わすれとる is the old-man, dialect way of saying わすれている. わすれとる = 'I've forgotten'.
